theme: An open day in St. Pete, with the trip clock ticking
greeting: A quiet calendar today, Dan — one call at noon and the rest of the day your own, with the girls in the house. The open stretch is good cover for the networking replies and the Croatia bookings that are stacking up before the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Pick a time with Lauren at Brunswick
needsAttention.detail: Lauren Nadig came back with three Teams windows -- Thu Sept 3 (3:30-5:30 ET), Tue Sept 8 (1-5), and Wed Sept 9 -- and is waiting on you to choose one before she sends a scheduler.

needsAttention.title: Send your bio to Ellen and Deb
needsAttention.detail: Your own note today is to send your email and bio to Ellen Richstone and Deb Rosenthal after the NACD New England call; the Oct 28 event prep session is now set for Oct 8 at 1pm ET.

needsAttention.title: Croatia bookings before you fly Sept 8
needsAttention.detail: Two past-due p1 items hit a hard wall at departure: the Cavtat hotel night for Sept 19 and the St Pete landing-gap nights of Sept 20-21. Charter Wi-Fi is unreliable, so both need locking from shore first.

acts.line: An open morning -- nothing on the calendar before noon.
A single hour at midday for the NACD New England call, then the day clears.
The evening is yours in St. Petersburg, with the four girls at home.
